ir.title: RuntimeFixture
ir.coverage_contract: 在明确限定的模型、输入范围和运行模式内，完整覆盖并验证所有分支。任何任意 PyTorch 模型均无 opaque 无法保证：未知自定义算子、外部依赖或动态 Python 行为可能无法从现有证据中还原。

unknown_boundary.policy: source operands retained; no runtime execution or identity guess
source operands retained; no runtime execution or identity guess

limitations: Declared samples and modes only; not arbitrary-input coverage or old/new equivalence.
Model and instrumentation share the isolated process; not adversarial attestation.
No checkpoint, optimizer or training progress is loaded or migrated.

environment.environmentFreezeScope: all venv files including bytecode, resolved Python executable, standard library excluding base site-packages, ELF dependency closure, config, dependency lock and trusted adapter; executable/stdlib/ELF mounts are private read-only copies, venv bytes are rechecked after execution

limits.threadLimitScope: RLIMIT_NPROC counts all tasks for the real host UID; seccomp separately denies new processes
limits.memoryScope: per-process virtual address space; no cgroup RSS or aggregate tmpfs quota

manifest.observationMechanism: original Summary AST branches + nn.Module calls + TorchDispatchMode ATen operands/source stack

formalProbe.mechanism: Linux Bubblewrap user/mount/pid/net/ipc/uts namespaces and mandatory x86-64 seccomp
formalProbe.network: separate namespace plus socket/socketpair syscall denial
formalProbe.processLimit: non-thread clone/fork/vfork denied; clone3 ENOSYS; RLIMIT_NPROC thread budget

runtime.instrumentation: AST if/ifexp outcomes + nn.Module hooks + TorchDispatchMode ATen operands

coverage.scope: declared concrete input set × declared modes; selected forward and expanded local helper source
coverage.reason: unobserved/unsupported source, failed run, or input domain not exhaustively declared

limitations: Static edges express source dependencies, not observed tensor bindings.
Unresolved calls/loops/external definitions remain explicit opaque boundaries.
Mutation updates proven direct aliases only; views, external aliases and interprocedural effects remain unresolved.
Notebook cells are parsed as data; notebook setup/training cells are never executed.

module_associations.basis: unique static module path and class in the same source generation and constructor configuration

trace_groups.scope: same recorded hierarchy, operators, source locations, tensor dtypes, slots, branches and mode
same recorded hierarchy, operators, source locations, tensor dtypes, slots, branches and mode
